questions.question: How many two-digit numbers are divisible by 11?
questions.solution:
The two-digit numbers which are divisible by 11 are 11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88, 99.

Hence, there are 9 two-digit number which are divisible by 11.

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a work in 5, 10 and 30 days respectively. In how many days A, B and C together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
A alone can do a work = 5 days

A’s one day’s work = 1/5

B alone can do the work = 10 days

B’s one-day’s work = 1/10

C alone can do the work = 30 days

C’s one-day’s work = 1/30

A, B and C together can do the work in,

(A + B + C)’s one-day’s work = (1/5 + 1/10 + 1/30) = (6 + 3 + 1)/30 = 10/30 = 1/3

Hence, A + B + C can complete the whole work in 3 days.

questions.question: P, Q and R together can complete a work in 10 days. P alone can complete the work in 30 days. In how many days Q and R together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given,

(P + Q + R) can complete a work in 10 days.

⇒ (P + Q + R)’s one day work = 1/10

P alone can complete the work in 30 days.

⇒ P’s one day work = 1/30

⇒ (Q + R)’s one day work = (1/10 - 1/30) = (3 - 1)/30 = 2/30 = 1/15

Q + R can complete the same work in 15 days.

questions.question: What is the area (in cm²) of circle having circumference of 44 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Circumference of the circle = 44 cm.

**Formula Used: **

⇒ Circumference of the circle = 2πr.

⇒ Area of the circle = πr². 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Circumference of the circle = 44

⇒ 2πr = 44

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 44

⇒ r = 7 cm. 

Now,

**Area of the circle = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 154 cm².**

questions.question: What is the average of first 8 odd numbers?
questions.solution:
We know that,

The sum of first ‘n’ odd number = n²

⇒ The sum of first 8 odd number = 8²

⇒ The sum of first 8 odd number = 64

Average of first 8 odd number = 64/8 = 8

questions.question: If the cost price of 6 articles is equal to the selling price of 9 articles, then what is the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of 1 article be Rs. 1

The cost price of 6 articles = Rs.6

Given,

The cost price of 6 articles = The selling price of 9 articles

∴ The selling price of 9 articles = Rs.6

And the cost price of 9 article = Rs.9

We know that,

Loss% = frac{{C.P - S.P}}{{C.P}} times 100 = frac{{9 - 6}}{9} times 100 = frac{{100}}{3} = 33.33\%

questions.question: A man gains 50% by selling an article at a certain price. If he sells the article at half the price, then what is the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of an article be Rs. x

Gain = 50%

S.P = C.P + Gain

⇒ S.P = x + 50x/100 = 150x/100 = 3x/2

If he sells the article at half the price, the selling price will be

S.P = 3x/4

Loss% = frac{{C.P - S.P}}{{C.P}} times 100 = frac{{x - 3x/4}}{x} times 100 = (x)/({4x)} times 100 = 25\%

questions.question: If the length of a rectangle is increased by 20%, then by how much percent its breadth should be reduced so that the area remains the same?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the rectangle increased = 20%

Area of the rectangle remained unchanged.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Area of the rectangle = L × B

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area of the rectangle = L × B

⇒ New Length of the rectangle = L + 0.2L = 1.2L

Now,

Let the new breadth of the rectangle be 'Y'.

⇒ Area of the rectangle = 1.2L × Y

⇒ L × B = 1.2L × Y

⇒ Y = (10/12) × B

⇒ Y = (5/6) × B.

If, 

⇒ Old Breadth = 6x, then New Breadth = 5x

⇒ Change in Breadth = x

**∴ Percentage change in Breadth = (x/6x) × 100 = 16.66%.**

questions.question: If speed of boat in still water is 10 km/hr and the speed of stream is 2 km/hr, then what is the upstream and downstream speeds (in km/hr) of the boat?
questions.solution:
The speed of boat in still water = u = 10 km/hr.

The speed of current = v = 2 km/hr

⇒ The downstream of boat = u + v = 12 km/hr

⇒ The upstream of boat = u - v = 10 - 2 = 8 km/hr

questions.question: A train is 400 metres long and running at a speed of 60 km/hr. How much time (in seconds) will it take to cross a platform 1000 metres long?
questions.solution:
Given, The length of train = 400 metres

Length of platforms = 1000 metres

Speed of train = 60 km/hr = 60 × (5/18) = 50/3

Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ Time = frac{{1000 + 400}}{{50/3}} = 84 seconds

questions.question: What is the percentage increase in Soybean import in the year 2012 in comparison to year 2011?
questions.solution:
The import of soybean in the year 2011 = 120 quintals

The import of soybean in the year 2012 = 340 quintals

Percentage increase = (340 - 120) × 100/120 = 183.33%

questions.question: In how many years the import of Soybean is more than the average import of Soybean for the given years?
questions.solution:

The import of soybean for 2014 = 225 quintals

The import of soybean for 2015 = 390 quintals

The import of soybean for 2016 = 720 quintals

In 2013 and 2016, the import of soybean is more than the average import.
